research_status: exploratory retrospective SAME already observed ESA mission and exposed test IDs; NOT novel blind confirmatory evaluation
event_partition: exact original V1.5 global-ID event-aware chronological train/validation/test; reuse for matched baseline; no read of test for fitting threshold/transition/selection
risk_input: max absolute robust-scale deviation of last real 3-channel readings; RobustLevelDeviation fitted on 20,000 pure nominal training windows; same as prior V1.5 baseline
emission: train-only univariate Gaussian over log(1+risk) for 3 initialized risk tiers, variance floor 0.0036; priors smoothed with 0.5
transition: count adjacent pseudo-state pairs only among consecutive stride4 pure nominal training windows; Dirichlet additive 0.5; no transitions over gap/invalid/segment boundaries
score: baseline robust raw deviation; others 1-p(normal reference tier), no probability-of-physical-fault claim
metric_units: validation AP only for diagnostic; no model selection
false alarm starts per 30 elapsed days
evaluation: true ESA official target-channel Anomaly positive, rare nominal negative; masked context-only anomaly and invalid windows excluded identically to V1.5
limitations: Offline analysis of previously exposed test IDs, not fresh blind test
Weak risk tiers have human-defined meaning; NO verified healthy/degraded/physical failure labels
Repeated 10-minute as-of sampling NOT official ESA 30-second preprocessing
State transition estimated from continuous nominal risk tiers, not independently annotated physical state transition labels
No new human-reconfirmed abnormal labels nor real expert 0-100 health score anchors
HMM time inference only in chronological windows; never leak future readings
Window-level labels refer to true ESA target code at causal end, not physical fault severity
Core original MSF-MOFS max64 feature-budget remains separately frozen in OPS-SAT branch, not implemented in this lightweight real ESA HMM baseline
Threshold and persistence do not change after seeing test outcomes
No automatic update or clinical/flight critical decision
